summary: REGRESSION NOT RESOLVED. The iteration-5 fix added queryClient.setQueryData in bindRevenueCatIdentity so the react-query customer-info cache is updated immediately after Purchases.logIn, plus a defensive Purchases.getCustomerInfo() re-check inside paywall's onPurchase. Backend regression is clean: 31/31 pytest suite still green (auth, PATCH /auth/me, recipes, likes/saves/history, subscription, AI + save-generated + numeric coercion, meal-plan CRUD + gating, prefs + cuisines + skill_level; 10.06s). Frontend (390x844, deployed URL, cook@owami.app): app boots, no red 'Purchases unavailable' banner ever appears, RC SDK inits ('Web platform detected. Using RevenueCat in Browser Mode' / 'Preview API Mode'), offerings load correctly (paywall-option-$rc_monthly 'Pro monthly · $9.99', paywall-option-$rc_annual 'Pro annual · Best value · $15.99'). BUT tapping paywall-subscribe after selecting monthly STILL shows 'Sign in first, then try again.' via paywall-error and the confirm modal (paywall-confirm-cancel / paywall-confirm-purchase) NEVER opens. RCA below.

ui_bugs.issue: paywall-subscribe → confirm modal still does not open after sign-in on web. paywall-error text 'Sign in first, then try again.' shown. Confirmed via runtime instrumentation that identityReady stays false because Purchases.logIn(userId) on purchases-js Browser Mode resolves but returns a CustomerInfo whose originalAppUserId is STILL the anonymous $RCAnonymousID:… (see RCA). Reference: /app/frontend/src/lib/revenuecat.tsx:117 (logIn call) and /app/frontend/app/paywall.tsx:55-64 (defensive re-check).

integration_issues.flow: RevenueCat identity on web preview (purchases-js Browser Mode)
integration_issues.issue: purchases-js v1.54.0 (react-native-purchases web shim) does not actually change the SDK's identity when Purchases.logIn(userId) is called — the returned customerInfo.originalAppUserId remains the $RCAnonymousID assigned at configure time. As a result, both bindRevenueCatIdentity's setQueryData path AND paywall's defensive Purchases.getCustomerInfo() re-check see an anonymous id, and identityReady stays false forever on web. The confirm modal is unreachable on web preview.

action_items: CRITICAL: change the identity strategy on web. The cleanest fix is to configure Purchases with the appUserID at init time rather than relying on Purchases.logIn afterwards: `Purchases.configure({ apiKey, appUserID: userId })`. This requires deferring initializeRevenueCat until the auth session is restored (or re-initializing inside SubscriptionProvider/RevenueCatIdentityBinder once user.id is known). Purchases-js honors appUserID at configure — logIn on Browser Mode does not swap the id.

ALTERNATIVE fix (simpler): on Platform.OS === 'web' && rcEnabled, override identityReady to true whenever a real auth user exists (`identityReady = Platform.OS === 'web' ? !!user?.id : (!!originalAppUserId && !originalAppUserId.startsWith('$RCAnonymousID:'))`). Test Store on web preview does not need a real RC-side identity — purchases still route via the Test Store and no real charge occurs. This unblocks the confirm modal on web without touching the SDK.
Also remove or relax the defensive Purchases.getCustomerInfo() guard in paywall.tsx onPurchase() since on web it will always see an anon id and short-circuit; keep it only for native.

Web-SDK reference for main agent to consult (may need websearch): 'react-native-purchases-js logIn does not change app_user_id in Browser Mode' / 'purchases-js configure appUserID vs logIn'. If a purchases-js version >1.54 or a documented API exists to switch identity post-configure, use that instead of the alternative above.

Optional (pre-existing, unresolved from iter 4/5): profile.tsx has both a new row-preferences ('Cooking preferences') and an unwired row-diet ('Dietary preferences'). Consider removing row-diet or wiring it.
critical_code_review_comments: bindRevenueCatIdentity fix in /app/frontend/src/lib/revenuecat.tsx:114 correctly threads queryClient and calls setQueryData(['revenuecat','customer-info'], customerInfo) after Purchases.logIn. However the customerInfo returned by purchases-js on web is still anonymous, so setQueryData writes an anon CustomerInfo → identityReady derived from that is still false.

RevenueCatIdentityBinder in /app/frontend/src/components/revenuecat-identity-binder.tsx correctly passes queryClient into bindRevenueCatIdentity via useQueryClient() and re-runs on user?.id changes. Verified via instrumentation the useEffect fires and calls bindRevenueCatIdentity with the real backend user id after sign-in.

paywall.tsx defensive re-fetch (lines 55-64) still fails on web because Purchases.getCustomerInfo() also returns the anonymous customerInfo. This defense adds no value on web unless combined with the alternative fix in action items.

initializeRevenueCat() is called at module scope in _layout.tsx BEFORE auth is restored, so we can't yet know user.id. Consider moving the .configure() call into an effect gated on user.id so appUserID can be supplied at configure time — this is the canonical purchases-js pattern.

No red banner is rendered because Purchases.logIn resolves successfully (no throw); the catch in the binder never fires. So the failure is silent — matches the observed 'no error, no modal' UX from iter 5.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% — offerings/paywall render, gating & profile correct, restore doesn't crash, no red banner; blocker: paywall-subscribe confirm modal still unreachable on web because purchases-js logIn does not swap identity

Runtime-verified in iter 6: [bind] calls Purchases.logIn(<userId>), it resolves, but the returned customerInfo.originalAppUserId is still $RCAnonymousID:… — purchases-js Browser Mode ignores post-configure identity change. rca_of_issue:
BUG (persists from iter 5): paywall confirm modal never opens on web preview.
REPRO: sign in as cook@owami.app → open /paywall → wait ≥6s → tap paywall-option-$rc_monthly → tap paywall-subscribe → observe paywall-error='Sign in first, then try again.', no modal.
ROOT CAUSE (new, verified via injected console.log): the fix in /app/frontend/src/lib/revenuecat.tsx bindRevenueCatIdentity DOES run — Purchases.logIn(userId) is invoked with the correct backend user id — but purchases-js v1.54.0 in Browser Mode returns a CustomerInfo whose originalAppUserId is STILL the anonymous ID that was assigned during Purchases.configure(). Trace captured:
  [bind] calling Purchases.logIn( de5b1a3f-d6f5-461e-99c8-1d4634e72482 )
  [bind] logIn resolved. originalAppUserId= $RCAnonymousID:a4f4ac3527114cb2b7e4abf83ce573fd
Because setQueryData is called with that anon CustomerInfo, useSubscription().identityReady stays false. Paywall's onPurchase's defensive re-check (Purchases.getCustomerInfo()) then also returns anon and setErr('Sign in first, then try again.') is shown. NO error is ever thrown so the identity-binder banner never renders.
MITIGATION (choose one; needs main-agent code change):
  (A) Re-configure RC with appUserID once the auth user is known: replace the module-scope initializeRevenueCat() with a hook that Purchases.configure({ apiKey, appUserID: user.id }) inside RevenueCatIdentityBinder (guarded by _initialized flag reset). purchases-js honors appUserID at configure.
  (B) Bypass the check on web: in revenuecat.tsx compute `identityReady = Platform.OS === 'web' ? true : !originalAppUserId?.startsWith('$RCAnonymousID:')` — safe because Test Store purchases on web preview are simulated and no real charge occurs. Also remove/short-circuit the defensive Purchases.getCustomerInfo() guard in paywall.tsx on web.
NOTE: Backend 31/31 still passes; all other iter-5 passes remain (offerings render, icons/splash intact, restore doesn't crash, gating works, profile subscription rows correct).
